_meta.description: Manual curation of bank tech stacks for top 50 European banks. Focus: core banking, TF/SCF platform (or absence), TCI partnerships, ERP integration profile. Used as Signal 6 (pre-integration friction) in BIS.
_meta.credable_friction_scale: low (Finastra/Temenos pre-integrated, fast onboarding) | medium (custom integration but feasible) | high (proprietary core, significant effort)
_meta.verification_level: training_data_inference + public_information — to be re-validated bank-by-bank during sales discovery
_meta._critical_signal: Banks on Finastra Fusion = pre-integrated CredAble = friction MINIMAL. Priority targets.

banks.name: BCGE
banks.rationale: Avaloq core (Swiss leader). No public Finastra. Custom integration needed for SCF module. Recent recruitment of Eric Balmer (ex-CEO Global SCF Ltd) signals readiness. Estimated effort: 3-4 months custom.

banks.name: Komerční banka
banks.tf_scf_platform: ORPHANED — Roger acquired by Orbian Feb 2025
banks.rationale: Loss of Roger fintech partner is critical. Current state: factoring KB filiale operates with legacy. Pre-integration with SAP common (Czech corporates use SAP heavily). MEDIUM friction: SG group decision-making but local autonomy on factoring KB.

banks.name: Bankinter
banks.rationale: Proprietary core + own platform = hardest to displace. BUT: cross-border / CEE expansion potentially addressable as MODULE on top of their existing platform. Pitch should be 'extension', not 'replacement'.

banks.name: BPER Banca
banks.tf_scf_platform: PlusAdvance partnership (Confirming, Dynamic Discounting, Reverse Factoring) — May 2023
banks.rationale: PlusAdvance is a smaller Italian fintech (not in our major-competitor exclusion list). Post-BPS fusion Apr 2026 = rationalization opportunity. Can position CredAble as upgrade for combined entity.

banks.name: Banca Transilvania
banks.rationale: ★ FINASTRA pre-integrated → CredAble friction minimal. EBRD program oct 2024 = appetite proven. Top candidate. Estimated time-to-deploy: 2-3 months.

banks.name: BayernLB
banks.tf_scf_platform: Multibank concept page only (no operational platform)
banks.rationale: German Landesbank, slower decision but big balance sheet. SCF concept exists, no platform. Florian Seitz (Head TEF) accessible. Pitch: full white-label.

banks.name: Helaba
banks.rationale: Helaba mentioned 'expanded collaboration with supply chain finance platforms' in 2024 annual report = no own product. White space.

banks.name: Belfius Bank
banks.rationale: Sopra Banking common in BE. Belfius Commercial Finance is a factoring filiale, no SCF platform. 6th 'Best TF Bank Belgium' = strong TF, weak SCF tech = perfect fit.

banks.name: La Banque Postale
banks.tf_scf_platform: LBP Leasing & Factoring (filiale, no SCF tech)
banks.rationale: GTR Dec 2025 CPRI mention = active TF documentary. Filiale factoring exists, SCF tech missing. State-owned = procurement cycles longer.

banks.name: Banco BPM
banks.rationale: Operational outsourcing in 2021 = wants to externalize SCF. Re-internalization via white-label could appeal post-financial review.

banks.name: KBC Bank
banks.tf_scf_platform: ORPHANED — we.trade shutdown June 2022, KBC was founding shareholder
banks.rationale: we.trade orphan + KBC Commercial Finance filiale. Multi-country CEE filiales (ČSOB CZ, K&H HU, UBB BG) = cross-sell potential. Decision in Brussels.

banks.name: Citi Handlowy
banks.rationale: Citi global infra = displacing internally near-impossible. BUT: their May 2025 PR explicitly mentions SCF as growth pillar = potential modular/local module pitch. Decision: NYC + Warsaw.

banks.name: Bank Millennium
banks.rationale: Portuguese BCP parent. Best TF Services Poland 2025 (Global Finance) = strong TF, internal training in SCF = ramping up. White space.

banks.name: NLB d.d.
banks.tf_scf_platform: NLB Factoring app (proprietary, includes reverse factoring, low scalability)
banks.rationale: Own Factoring app exists but not scalable. Modernization in progress. 7-country SEE network = strong cross-sell potential. Andrej Lasic (CIB Board) accessible.

banks.name: BRD-SocGen
banks.rationale: SG group = decision Paris. FINTRA leader factoring but no SCF. Best TF Provider Romania 2025. Difficult sale due to SG infrastructure constraints.

banks.name: BCV
banks.rationale: Cantonal bank Vaud, Avaloq core. Trade finance international but no SCF signal. Lower priority than BCGE.

banks.name: PKO BP
banks.rationale: Polish #1 bank. Asseco core (could be advantage if Asseco-CredAble integration possible). PKO Faktoring filiale operational.

banks.name: Bank Pekao
banks.rationale: Polish #2 bank. Post-UniCredit divestment, decision local. SCF tech absent.

banks.name: mBank
banks.tf_scf_platform: mFaktoring (FCI member, factoring only, proprietary 'Client Manager')
banks.rationale: Commerzbank parent. Tech autonomy in PL good. SCF gap clear.

banks.name: ČSOB CZ
banks.rationale: Filiale KBC = decision Brussels. KBC orphaned post-we.trade. Possible group-level CredAble pitch.

banks.name: VÚB Banka
banks.rationale: Intesa filiale, decision Milano. Hard sell due to ISP corporate group standards.

banks.name: Tatra banka
banks.rationale: RBI group SCF available = effectively equipped. EXCLU candidate.

banks.name: K&H Bank
banks.rationale: KBC filiale, decision Brussels. Same as ČSOB.

banks.name: CIB Bank
banks.rationale: ISP filiale, decision Milano. SCF non-explicit, but ISP group has own confirming. EXCLU candidate.

banks.name: ING Bank Romania
banks.rationale: ING filiale, decision Amsterdam. Touchstone proprietary.

banks.name: BGK
banks.rationale: Polish development bank. Acts as guarantor on SCF programs. Could be partner channel rather than client.

banks.name: DSK Bank
banks.rationale: OTP filiale = group SCF available. EXCLU candidate.

banks.name: UniCredit Bulbank
banks.rationale: UC filiale, decision Milano. UC group has own SCF. EXCLU candidate.

banks.name: Zagrebačka banka
banks.rationale: UC filiale. EXCLU candidate.

banks.name: PBZ
banks.rationale: ISP filiale. EXCLU candidate.

banks.name: OTP banka Slovenija
banks.rationale: OTP filiale post-fusion (SKB+Nova KBM). EXCLU likely.

banks.name: MAIB
banks.tf_scf_platform: Proprietary factoring app (recourse, without recourse, reverse — non-scalable)
banks.rationale: ★ FINASTRA pre-integrated → friction minimal. Already has reverse factoring concept = ready to upgrade. Top candidate Moldova. C3 country = trade documentaire fort = TCI integration MAJEUR différenciateur CredAble.

banks.name: Luminor
banks.rationale: Pan-Baltic post DNB+Nordea merger (2017). FIS Profile = legacy migration target. Structure régionale = single platform multi-country opportunity.

banks.name: LHV Pank
banks.rationale: ★ Digital-native bank. APIs first. Excellent integration capability. Factoring + credit insurance documented. Open to fintech partnerships.

banks.name: Citadele
banks.rationale: Privatized 2012, EBRD shareholder. FIS core + EBRD link = potential SCF program candidate.

banks.name: Šiaulių Bankas
banks.rationale: Lithuanian factoring leader. Asseco regional core.

banks.name: Liberty Bank
banks.rationale: FCI new member 2025. FIS core. C3 country = TF documentaire dominant. CredAble TCI integration addresses gap.

banks.name: PASHA Bank
banks.rationale: ★ FINASTRA pre-integrated. Export factoring on homepage = active TF. C3-C4 country, TF documentary essential.

banks.name: Ameriabank
banks.rationale: ★ FINASTRA pre-integrated. Top Armenian bank. C3 country.

banks.name: Ardshinbank
banks.rationale: ★ FINASTRA pre-integrated. Competing with Ameriabank.

banks.name: Inecobank
banks.rationale: ★ Digital-native, strong tech appetite. Open to fintech.

banks.name: BKT
banks.rationale: ★ FINASTRA pre-integrated. Albanian leader + Kosovo subsidiary. First mover potential.

banks.name: AIK Bank
banks.rationale: Best Bank Serbia 2024 (Euromoney). Post-fusion mar 2025.

banks.name: NLB Komercijalna
banks.rationale: NLB filiale, decision Ljubljana. Group rollout opportunity.

banks.name: UniCredit Bank BiH
banks.rationale: UC filiale. EXCLU candidate.

banks.name: Raiffeisen Bank BiH
banks.rationale: RBI filiale = group SCF available. EXCLU.

banks.name: Komercijalna Banka
banks.rationale: Macedonian #1 bank.

banks.name: Nordea
banks.rationale: ★ Nordics, CredAble has Norway+Sweden booking centres = local presence. we.trade orphan. Multi-Nordic SCF opportunity. NEW addition to catalog.

banks.name: Handelsbanken
banks.rationale: Swedish leader. Conservative bank. NEW addition.

banks.name: SEB
banks.rationale: Swedish corp banking leader. Proprietary tech. NEW addition.

banks.name: DNB
banks.rationale: Norwegian leader. CredAble Norway booking centre = local presence advantage. NEW addition.

banks.name: BCR (Banca Comerciala Romana)
banks.tf_scf_platform: Erste Group SCF (group program, limited local autonomy)
banks.rationale: Romania #1 bank (Erste subsidiary). Finastra NOT used — Erste uses T24. Group SCF exists but local scope. Decision shared Wien/Bucharest. Large SME base = strong pipeline.

banks.name: Raiffeisen Bank Romania
banks.rationale: RBI filiale, decision Vienna. RBI group SCF = EXCLU likely. Best TF Bank Romania. Strong corporate client base.

banks.name: CEC Bank
banks.rationale: Romanian state development bank. T24 core. No SCF platform. State ownership = procurement process long but strategic mandate for SME/export = aligned with CredAble offer.

banks.name: Erste Bank Serbia
banks.rationale: Erste Serbia. No Finastra = no pre-integration. But Erste group appetite for SCF proven (BCR). Local decision possible on module basis.

banks.name: ProCredit Holding
banks.rationale: ★ CEE SME specialist. 8 countries (DE, SE, GE, UA, RS, AL, MK, EC). Digital-native approach, open to fintech partnerships. SCF = natural add-on to their SME mandate. Frankfurt decision centre = accessible.

banks.name: TBC Bank
banks.rationale: ★ Georgian digital leader (LSE:TBCG). Cloud-native, API-first. Strong SME/corporate. Trade finance growth pillar. Active M&A (TBC Uzbekistan). C3 country = documentary trade essential. Top candidate.

banks.name: Bank of Georgia (Lion Finance Group)
banks.rationale: ★ Georgia #1 bank (LSE:BGEO, renamed Lion Finance Group 2025). Digital-native, fintech-forward. Direct competitor to TBC = both are top targets. C3 country trade finance.

banks.name: OTP Bank Group
banks.tf_scf_platform: OTP SCF program (group, operational in HU + select markets)
banks.rationale: OTP parent (11 CEE countries). Group SCF exists but limited cross-border reach. Local subsidiary pitch possible. Hungarian decision = faster than G-SIB filiales. OTP expanding via acquisitions = rollout opportunity.

banks.name: MBH Bank (ex-MKB)
banks.rationale: Post-merger bank (3-way fusion 2022). Integration still ongoing = platform rationalization window. SCF tech absent. Hungarian #2 bank. Decision: local.

banks.name: LBBW (Landesbank Baden-Württemberg)
banks.tf_scf_platform: LBBW Supply Chain Finance (operational, own platform)
banks.rationale: Germany #4 bank. Active SCF platform for automotive/industrial supply chains (strong in BW). SAP native = ERP integration natural. Cross-border expansion potential = CredAble add-on pitch.

banks.name: Nord/LB (Norddeutsche Landesbank)
banks.rationale: German Landesbank (Lower Saxony). FIS core. No SCF platform public. Strong agri/energy/maritime TF = niche. Post-restructuring (2019) = leaner, more decisive.

banks.name: Banco Sabadell
banks.rationale: Spanish #4 bank. Own confirming product (BS Confirming). UK expansion (TSB). Under BBVA takeover bid (2025) = management uncertainty but local ops stable. Cross-border SCF gap.

banks.name: Crédit Mutuel
banks.tf_scf_platform: CIC Trade Finance (own, through CIC filiale)
banks.rationale: French cooperative #3. CIC filiale handles corporate TF. Complex mutual structure = long decisions. SCF positioning through CIC corporate arm = possible but requires regional buy-in.

banks.name: BPCE / Natixis
banks.tf_scf_platform: Natixis Trade Finance (CIB arm, own documentary platform)
banks.rationale: French cooperative #2 (Natixis CIB). Own TF platform via Natixis. Coface shareholder = TCI integrated. Complex structure. SCF gap at regional caisses level = potential for white-label module.

banks.name: Unicaja Banco
banks.rationale: ★ Spanish regional #5. T24 post-merger = Finastra-adjacent friction. No SCF product. Strong Andalusia/Extremadura SME base. Post-merger platform rationalization = SCF add-on window open.

banks.name: BFF Bank
banks.tf_scf_platform: BFF own factoring platform (public sector receivables specialist)
banks.rationale: ★ Italian factoring specialist (public sector + healthcare + supply chain). API-first, strong tech. Potential PARTNER rather than just client — distribution channel for CredAble in CEE. Milan listed.

banks.name: Kapital Bank
banks.rationale: Azerbaijani state-owned bank. Oracle FLEXCUBE core. C3-C4 country = documentary trade dominant. State ownership = procurement formal. PASHA Bank competitor = both viable.

banks.name: TBC Bank Uzbekistan
banks.rationale: ★ TBC Group Uzbekistan expansion (fast-growing). Digital-native. C4 country = documentary trade + SCF = strong fit. First mover opportunity in UZ. TBC Group tech = excellent API capability.

banks.name: Evocabank
banks.rationale: ★ Armenian digital bank. Cloud-native, API-first, fintech approach. No legacy. Open to partnerships. C3 country = TCI integration differentiator. Smaller than Ameriabank but faster to decide.

banks.name: Halyk Bank
banks.rationale: Kazakhstan #1 bank (LSE:HSBK). Oracle FLEXCUBE core. No SCF tech public. Strong corporate/trade finance. C3-C4 country = documentary trade. Belt & Road corridor = cross-border SCF growing need.

banks.name: Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine
banks.tf_scf_platform: RBI Capital Solutions (group, limited local deployment)
banks.rationale: RBI Ukraine (RBI group reducing exposure post-2022). Post-war reconstruction = massive trade finance need. EU accession track = documentary TF + SCF growth. Local decision on Ukraine-specific programs.

banks.name: ProCredit Bank Georgia
banks.rationale: ★ ProCredit Georgia subsidiary. SME-focused digital bank. ProCredit group open to fintech. C3 country = TCI integration key. Complements TBC Bank pitch in Georgia.

banks.name: Sparkasse / DSGV
banks.tf_scf_platform: DekaBank + DZ Bank group TF modules
banks.rationale: German savings bank network (DSGV). OSPlus core + DZ Bank group services. Strong SME/Mittelstand banking. Modular add-on pitch for SCF via DZ/Finanz Informatik channel possible.

banks.name: BNP Paribas Bank Polska
banks.tf_scf_platform: BNP Paribas Trade Finance (group, documentary + SCF)
banks.rationale: BNP Paribas group = decision Paris. Own TF platform. BUT: Polish corporate book large = local module pitch possible. Post-Raiffeisen PL acquisition 2018 = platform integration still ongoing.

banks.name: Alior Bank
banks.rationale: ★ Polish digital bank (PZU Group). Cloud-native, API-first. No SCF platform. Strong SME/mid-corp growth. Digital-native = fast integration. Decision Warsaw = local.

banks.name: Addiko Bank
banks.rationale: ★★ FINASTRA pre-integrated × 5 CEE markets (AT, HR, SI, RS, BA). Specialty focus = consumer + SME. No SCF tech. Single-platform rollout in 5 countries = maximum leverage for CredAble. Vienna decision = accessible. TOP candidate.

banks.name: ABN AMRO
banks.tf_scf_platform: ABN AMRO Trade Finance (own, strong documentary + SCF for corporates)
banks.rationale: Dutch #2 bank. Strong trade finance (GTBA award). Atradius shareholder = TCI embedded. Own SCF platform for Dutch corporates. CEE extension = white space. Dutch sustainability mandate = ESG-linked SCF pitch.

banks.name: Rabobank
banks.tf_scf_platform: Rabobank Trade Finance (own, agri/food supply chain specialist)
banks.rationale: Dutch cooperative, global agri/food trade finance leader. Own SCF for food supply chains. CEE agri sector = natural extension. Cooperative = longer decisions but strategic appetite for fintech.

banks.name: Commerzbank
banks.tf_scf_platform: Commerz Real Trade Finance (own SCF for Mittelstand)
banks.rationale: Germany #2 bank. Mittelstand champion = large SME SCF book. Own TF platform. CEE: Polish subsidiary mBank already in catalog. Under UniCredit takeover bid (2025) = management uncertainty. Cross-border SCF extension pitch.

banks.name: Garanti BBVA
banks.core_banking: BBVA group platform (Garanti proprietary + BBVA tech)
banks.tf_scf_platform: Garanti Trade Finance (own, strong documentary + SCF)
banks.rationale: Turkey #2 bank (BBVA subsidiary). Strong TF for Balkans/EU-Turkey corridor. Gateway for CredAble in Turkey + Balkan trade flows. Own SCF product — cross-border CEE extension = differentiator.

banks.name: DZ Bank
banks.rationale: Central bank for 700+ Volksbanken/Raiffeisen Germany. Proprietary TF platform. High friction. Strategic interest for cooperative bank distribution.

banks.name: Hamburg Commercial Bank
banks.rationale: Ex-HSH Nordbank, now private (Cerberus/JC Flowers). SAP core + Finastra Summit treasury. Restructuring mode, no SCF platform. LOW friction via Finastra. Strong shipping/trade focus.

banks.name: SaarLB
banks.rationale: Smallest German Landesbank (€16bn). Finastra Fusion core = pre-integrated CredAble. No SCF platform. Real estate + SME corporate focus. Fast deployment possible.

banks.name: ING Bank Śląski
banks.rationale: ING Group subsidiary. Group SCF platform deployed. High friction but regional customisation possible. Active in Polish corporate SCF.

banks.name: Santander Bank Polska
banks.rationale: Santander Group subsidiary. Trade Club deployed. Strong corporate trade finance presence in Poland. High friction — group decision required.

banks.name: Banca IFIS
banks.rationale: Pure factoring specialist (~€5bn). Temenos T24 core = LOW friction CredAble. No SCF platform despite being a factoring bank — manual processes. Strategic fit: CredAble as white-label digital layer.

banks.name: Piraeus Bank
banks.rationale: Largest Greek bank (€80bn). Temenos T24 + Finastra Summit = LOW friction. No SCF platform. Post-NPL restructuring focused on corporate growth. Strong trade finance appetite for Mediterranean routes.

banks.name: Alpha Bank
banks.rationale: 2nd largest Greek bank. Full Finastra stack (Fusion + Summit) = minimal integration effort for CredAble. No SCF platform. Corporate banking expansion post-restructuring.

banks.name: Eurobank
banks.rationale: 3rd Greek bank (€80bn). Temenos T24 = LOW friction. Active in Bulgaria (Postbank), Serbia, Cyprus. No SCF platform. Pan-Balkan expansion creates SCF opportunity.

banks.name: ING Bank Romania
banks.rationale: ING Group subsidiary Romania. Group SCF platform deployed. Top 5 Romanian corporate bank.

banks.name: Postbank Bulgaria (Eurobank)
banks.rationale: Eurobank subsidiary Bulgaria. Temenos T24. Growing corporate segment. No SCF platform.

banks.name: HPB (Hrvatska poštanska banka)
banks.rationale: State-owned Croatian postal bank. Asseco core. SME + public sector focus. No SCF platform. Growing trade finance ambition.

banks.name: Stopanska Banka
banks.rationale: NBG Group subsidiary (Greece). Temenos T24. Largest Macedonian bank. No SCF platform.

by_friction.low: ★ Banks with Finastra/cloud-native cores: Banca Transilvania, MAIB, PASHA Bank, Ameriabank, Ardshinbank, Inecobank, BKT, LHV Pank — these are TOP priority for fast deployment
by_friction.medium: 27 banks — typical European core (Sopra/Asseco/FIS) — feasible custom integration
by_friction.high: G-SIB filiales (UniCredit, ISP, KBC, ING, RBI, OTP filiales) + proprietary cores (Citi, Bankinter, SEB) — significant friction or EXCLU candidates

_summary.key_insight: The most actionable cluster is the 8 Finastra-pre-integrated banks across CEE/Balkans/Caucasus + 3 Nordic banks where CredAble has local booking centres. These should be prioritized over high-friction G-SIB filiales.
